heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 113–4, title IV, § 402(b)(1), Mar. 7, 2013, 127 Stat. 95

notes.text: Section 14043d–3, Pub. L. 103–322, title IV, § 41304, as added Pub. L. 109–162, title IV, § 401, Jan. 5, 2006, 119 Stat. 3020, authorized grants for the development of curricula and pilot programs for home visitation projects.

Section 14043d–4, Pub. L. 103–322, title IV, § 41305, as added Pub. L. 109–162, title IV, § 401, Jan. 5, 2006, 119 Stat. 3021, authorized grants for engaging men and youth in preventing domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, and stalking.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal not effective until the beginning of the fiscal year following Mar. 7, 2013, see section 4 of Pub. L. 113–4, set out as an Effective Date of 2013 Amendment note under section 2261 of Title 18, Crimes and Criminal Procedure.
